AudienceDefinitionWrite.title: AudienceDefinitionWrite
AudienceDefinitionWrite.description: Caller-native fields of the existing global ``audience_definition`` row.

GoogleFormsDefinitionResult.title: GoogleFormsDefinitionResult
GoogleFormsDefinitionResult.description: Safe bounded provider-native form definition; URLs and credentials are absent.

GoogleFormsResponsePage.title: GoogleFormsResponsePage
GoogleFormsResponsePage.description: One exact provider cursor page; response bodies are never persisted.

IdeaResearchCreateRequest.title: IdeaResearchCreateRequest
IdeaResearchCreateRequest.description: Create one provider-free Research container under an existing Idea.

voc_ids.title: Voc Ids
voc_ids.description: Current VOC children of this Idea. An empty list means none are attached; title and timestamps are not evidence of absence.

research_ids.title: Research Ids
research_ids.description: Current Research children of this Idea. An empty list means none are attached; title and timestamps are not evidence of absence.

IdeaWorkspacePreview.description: Bounded, recipient-free preview for the current Workspace snapshot.

IdeaWorkspacePreviewCriteriaSummary.description: Safe 17-dimension summary; values remain abstract filter values.

IdeaWorkspacePreviewRequest.title: IdeaWorkspacePreviewRequest
IdeaWorkspacePreviewRequest.description: An intentionally empty, typed request for the current Workspace preview.

PersonalVocCollectionRequest.title: PersonalVocCollectionRequest
PersonalVocCollectionRequest.description: VOC collection has its own journey confirmation contract.

report_source_fingerprint.title: Report Source Fingerprint
report_source_fingerprint.description: Exact server-observed provider fingerprint used to author this report. Use null only when the parent has no provider result fingerprint.

expected_parent_updated_at.title: Expected Parent Updated At
expected_parent_updated_at.description: Ignored compatibility field; current report pointers are last-write-wins.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: Provider-native payload. sql_lab requires SELECT/WITH SQL with exactly one outer numeric LIMIT 1..1000 and runAsync=false. chart_data requires queries containing 1..25 provider-native query objects, each with an integer row_limit 1..1000. The server supplies the configured database for sql_lab; do not select another database.

payload.sql: SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM verified_table LIMIT 20

SurveyMonkeyAttachRequest.title: SurveyMonkeyAttachRequest
SurveyMonkeyAttachRequest.description: Explicit recovery input for one ambiguous survey-create attempt.

body.title: Body
body.description: Provider-native body for SurveyMonkey POST /surveys. The platform validates bounds but does not rename, compile, or reinterpret fields.

VocBrief.title: VocBrief
VocBrief.description: Immutable provider-independent collection request confirmed by a PM.

VocCapabilitiesResponse.title: VocCapabilitiesResponse
VocCapabilitiesResponse.description: Compile-tested capability projection safe for Personal API clients.

VocCapabilityConfiguration.title: VocCapabilityConfiguration
VocCapabilityConfiguration.description: One exact VOC tuple accepted by the authoritative compiler.

VocCapabilityMarket.title: VocCapabilityMarket
VocCapabilityMarket.description: Market supported by the VOC adapters shipped with this API revision.

WorkspaceAudienceCriteria.title: WorkspaceAudienceCriteria
WorkspaceAudienceCriteria.description: Abstract filters only; never a recipient list or materialized snapshot.

WorkspaceQuestion.title: WorkspaceQuestion
WorkspaceQuestion.description: Draft-only questionnaire question; template binding happens at a gate.

WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization.title: WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization
WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization.description:
Server-resolved reusable Audience snapshot binding.

This is deliberately an opaque control-plane reference.  It contains no
filter, SQL, recipient data, or caller-selected storage location.
